summary: Iteration 22 both backend + frontend PASS. Backend pytest 3/3 (test_iteration22.py): (a) GET /api/public/b2b/<token> returns orders[].tracking for shipped orders with carrier, tracking_number, tracking_url (yurticikargo.com/...?code=<no> for yurtici), status 'in_transit', step 0..4, steps[5], estimated_delivery (shipped_at+3 fallback works), is_late bool, shipped_at, delivered_at; pending order has tracking=null. (b) POST /api/cargo/create-shipment for a pending order -> portal reflects new tracking with matching tracking_number + estimated_delivery (shipment doc default 2 days). Order + shipment reverted via direct DB. (c) Shift/leave conflict: POST /api/personnel/leaves (unpaid 2026-09-15..16) + /decide approve -> cells 09-15 and 09-16 carry leave{id,type,label='Ücretsiz'} with conflict=false when planned=false and total conflicts=0. PUT /api/personnel/shifts (09:00-18:00) returns warnings[0] containing 'izinli' and 'çakışıyor', message contains 'Uyarı'; GET again shows cell.planned=true, cell.conflict=true, grid.conflicts=1. PUT with off:true -> no warnings, conflict=false. Cleanup deleted shift + leave (used_leave_days untouched for unpaid). Frontend: /portal/57b063b0e3fb4e7e893b8429c3f8b654 at 390x844 and 1920 -> b2b-tracking-<order_number> card, b2b-tracking-link-<order_number> with href=yurticikargo.com...code=<tn> and target=_blank, b2b-eta-<order_number> visible; step bar renders; status label 'Yolda'; pending order shows 'Kargo bekleniyor'; mobile scrollWidth==clientWidth==390 (no horizontal overflow). /personnel?tab=attendance after login as admin@nexus.com: navigated to 2026-09-14 via shift-next-week, leave day cell shows 'Ücretsiz izinli' with amber classes; clicking cell opens shift-cell-editor with shift-leave-warning; entering 09:00-18:00 + shift-save triggers 'Plan kaldırıldı...' after reset. Body contains 'çakış' (toast+banner). shift-conflict-<empId>-2026-09-15 icon appears, shift-conflicts-banner reads '1 vardiya onaylı izin günüyle çakışıyor'. shift-reset removes plan -> banner and icon disappear. Cleanup deleted leave (status 200).
critical_code_review_comments: server._b2b_tracking correctly falls back estimated_delivery to shipped_at+3 days when the cargo_shipments row lacks one, and derives step from SHIPMENT_STEPS index; is_late compares against Europe/Istanbul today which is correct for Turkish users.
attendance.put_shifts and get_shifts share the same leave lookup semantics so the warnings emitted on PUT and the conflict counts returned by GET always agree; off:true correctly clears conflict.

B2BPortalParts.TrackingCard uses orderNumber for data-testid (b2b-tracking-<order_number>, b2b-tracking-link-<order_number>, b2b-eta-<order_number>) — note this deviates from the task description's <no>=tracking_number reading; if the intent was tracking_number consider aligning both, otherwise the current test-ids are stable and unique.

ShiftPlanner cell-editor's shift-off checkbox defaults to cell.off; on a leave-only cell where planned=false, off inherits schedule off value — the operator has to explicitly uncheck to trigger the conflict flow, which is intentional and matches the warning path.
